arguments.query: SELECT name, sql FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = 'table' ORDER BY name

SELECT 'config' AS kind, service AS id, value AS data FROM service_config
UNION ALL SELECT 'booking', booking_id, json_object('request_id',request_id,'flight_id',flight_id,'passenger_id',passenger_id,'amount_cents',amount_cents,'status',status,'client_reference',client_reference) FROM bookings WHERE status <> 'confirmed'
UNION ALL SELECT 'charge',charge_id,json_object('booking_id',booking_id,'key',idempotency_key,'amount',amount_cents,'state',state,'created_step',created_step) FROM charges WHERE booking_id IN (SELECT booking_id FROM bookings WHERE status <> 'confirmed')
UNION ALL SELECT 'event',event_id,json_object('booking_id',booking_id,'payload',payload,'status',status,'attempts',attempts) FROM outbox WHERE status <> 'delivered'
UNION ALL SELECT 'customer_event',event_id,json_object('request_id',request_id,'kind',kind,'step',step) FROM customer_events
UNION ALL SELECT 'flight',flight_id,json_object('capacity',capacity,'price',price_cents,'version',version,'held',(SELECT count(*) FROM holds WHERE holds.flight_id=flights.flight_id)) FROM flights
UNION ALL SELECT 'cache',key,value FROM cache

SELECT 'config' AS kind,service AS id,value AS data FROM service_config
UNION ALL SELECT 'event',o.event_id,json_object('booking_id',o.booking_id,'payload',o.payload,'status',o.status,'attempts',o.attempts,'booking_status',b.status,'flight_id',b.flight_id,'passenger_id',b.passenger_id) FROM outbox o LEFT JOIN bookings b ON b.booking_id=o.booking_id WHERE o.status='pending'
UNION ALL SELECT 'missing_event',b.booking_id,json_object('request_id',b.request_id,'status',b.status) FROM bookings b WHERE b.status='confirmed' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM outbox o WHERE o.booking_id=b.booking_id AND o.status<>'quarantined')
UNION ALL SELECT 'customer_event',event_id,json_object('request_id',request_id,'kind',kind,'step',step) FROM customer_events
UNION ALL SELECT 'pending',b.booking_id,json_object('request_id',b.request_id,'client_reference',b.client_reference,'held',h.booking_id IS NOT NULL) FROM bookings b LEFT JOIN holds h ON b.booking_id=h.booking_id WHERE b.status='pending'

SELECT b.rowid AS booking_order,b.*, (SELECT json_group_array(json_object('event_id',event_id,'kind',kind,'step',step)) FROM customer_events e WHERE e.request_id=b.request_id) AS customer_events, (SELECT json_group_array(json_object('charge_id',charge_id,'key',idempotency_key,'state',state,'amount',amount_cents)) FROM charges c WHERE c.booking_id=b.booking_id) AS charges FROM bookings b WHERE b.status<>'confirmed' OR b.client_reference IS NOT NULL ORDER BY b.rowid
